documents.title: Corrigendum To The Notice Of 34Th Annual General Meeting Of Shareholders Of Premier Polyfilm Limited
Clarification Letter On Price Movement Of Our Securities

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported a robust financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-2026, with net profit surging 22.60% to 3,188 lakhs alongside an increase in gross sales and other income to 34,126 lakhs. Production volume grew to 29,311 metric tonnes driven by enhanced capacity utilization from new plant and machinery. Management executed a strategic cost and margin management approach, secured an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park for logistics and trading activities, and placed an order for PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machines. Additionally, the company recommended a dividend of 15% (Rs. 0.15 per equity share) for the financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company secured and took possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and commenced logistics and trading activities.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: The company placed an order for manufacturing PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machines with advance payment made.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

margins_costs.claim: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic cost and margin management was complemented by discontinuing product lines with sub-optimal margins to focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.
margins_costs.quote: This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company arranged raw material at cheaper rates while selling finished goods at existing sales prices without devaluing them.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

margins_costs.claim: The company stopped production of some finished goods items that were not generating good profits.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The production volume increase is a direct result of enhanced capacity utilization following the successful commissioning of new plant and machinery during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: This increase is a direct result of enhanced capacity utilization following the successful commissioning of new plant and machinery during the year, which has strengthened our manufacturing capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved higher capacity utilization supported by the installation and utilization of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 15% (Rs. 0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/-) for the financial year 2025-2026.
capital_allocation.quote: “RESOLVED THAT a dividend of 15% (Rs.0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/-) as recommended by the Board of Directors be and is hereby declared out of the profits of the Company for the financial year 2025-2026.”

capital_allocation.claim: During the year under review, the Board transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: Unpaid or unclaimed dividend for FY 2017-2018 and specified equity shares were transferred by the Company to the IEPF.
capital_allocation.quote: During the FY 2025-2026, unpaid/ unclaimed dividend for the FY 2017-2018 aggregating to Rs.3,86,441/- and 1,42,110 numbers of equity shares with the face value of Rs.1/- each aggregating nominal value of Rs. 1,42,110/- for which dividend entitlements remained unpaid/ unclaimed for seven consecutive years or more, were transferred by the Company to IEPF established by the Central Government

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not accept unsecured loans from any of the directors or their relatives during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the company has not accepted money in the form of Unsecured Loan from any of the Directors and/ or their relative(s).

risks_headwinds.claim: The Company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding non-compliance due to delay in uploading Integrated Filing disclosures and paid a fine of Rs. 50,000/-.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) regarding non-compliance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) due to delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Regulations on the NEAPS portal.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in the past was attributed to economic slowdown and adverse market conditions prevailing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to fully switch to sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
